plugins.name: thor-thanos
plugins.description: A 10-second pixel-art fight loop along the bottom of the terminal, behind the chat. /thor-thanos turns it on and off.

plugins.name: firefly-meadow
plugins.description: A dusky meadow behind the desktop app, with fireflies that multiply as the context window fills, and a matching dusk color theme.

plugins.name: winter-night
plugins.description: A winter night behind the app: snow that falls harder as the context window fills, a storm as auto-compaction nears, and a matching color theme.
